R' Yosei: but is it not brine, whether a large quantity or a small one?
R' Yosei: and these are the permitted salt waters -- one puts oil at the outset into the water
...or [puts oil at the outset] into the salt
Shmuel: this is what [the mishna] says -- its 'brine' is a large quantity of salt water
Shmuel: one may not make a large quantity of salt water
Shmuel: but one may make a small quantity of salt water
Rav Yehuda: R' Yosei's 'is it not brine, whether much or little' is meant to permit
Rabba (and so R' Yochanan): R' Yosei's 'is it not brine, whether much or little' is meant to prohibit
per Rabba's reading: R' Yosei forbids even a small quantity of salt water
per Rav Yehuda's reading: R' Yosei permits even a large quantity of salt water
